Container.Name: Cairn
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted website archiver. Crawls whole sites to WARC, replays them in your browser, organizes them into folders and tags, and keeps them current from RSS feeds.
IMPORTANT — two settings that matter: 1. Put the Config path on a CACHE POOL, not the array. It holds a SQLite database, and SQLite on Unraid's /mnt/user FUSE layer with mover active can corrupt it. 2. Save your CAIRN_SECRET_KEY somewhere safe. Losing it makes stored cookies unrecoverable.

Config.Name: Replay Port
Config.Description: Archive replay (pywb). IF YOU CHANGE THIS, also set 'Replay browser port' below to the same number — this field only moves the host side of the mapping, and nothing inside the container can see what you picked, so the replay tab would keep pointing at 8081 and load nothing. Keep replay on a separate hostname from the WebUI if you expose this to the internet — ports alone do not isolate cookies.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database and settings. MUST be on a cache pool / SSD share set to cache-only. SQLite on the array with mover active can corrupt.

Config.Name: Archives
Config.Description: WARC storage. The array is fine here; this is where the bulk lives.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Encrypts stored cookies and signs sessions. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48 — SAVE THIS. Losing it makes stored credentials unrecoverable.

Config.Name: App public URL
Config.Description: External URL of the web UI, e.g. https://archive.example.com. Only needed if you reverse-proxy this.

Config.Name: Replay browser port
Config.Description: Only if you changed 'Replay Port' above: put the same number here. That field publishes the container's 8081 on a host port of your choosing, and the app has no way to learn which one you used — so without this it tells your browser 8081 and the replay tab loads nothing. Leave empty if you kept the default.

Config.Name: Replay public URL
Config.Description: External URL of the replay origin, e.g. https://replay.example.com. Must differ in HOSTNAME from the app URL, not just port — archived pages run JavaScript, and same-host means it can read your session cookie.

Config.Name: Max concurrent jobs
Config.Description: How many captures may run at once.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy
Config.Description: IP or CIDR of your reverse proxy. Only set this if you actually have one — it enables trusting X-Forwarded-For, which otherwise lets anyone spoof their address past the login rate limiter.

Config.Name: Fix permissions on boot
Config.Description: Set to 1 once if an existing /data tree has the wrong owner. Recursive chown over terabytes is slow — turn it back off afterwards.
